Game Overview

Military Strike puts players into a action experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Military Strike follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Military Strike?

Military Strike is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Military Strike free to play?

Yes, Military Strike is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
